correctness.rationale: Exact Catalan decomposition F=1+sum_j w_j (zF)^j, Lagrange inversion yields M_(m,s)=(n)_(m-1)/C_n * binom(2n-m-s,n-s), zero if s>n. For n>=3 and arbitrary repeated block sizes, the added-block ratio Q_(m,s)(b) is bounded by kappa_n mu_b, kappa_n=(2n-1)(n-1)/[(n+1)(2n-3)]; monotonicity in a=n-s,c=n-m and b, and tight pairs (1,1),(1,2),(2,1), justify all-order product kappa_n^(m-1). Distinct-size covariance and factorial variance follow algebraically. Independent rational small-n/m comparisons and inspected exhaustive checker corroborate, do not prove infinite bound.
